title: Agent wait loops on a check log are bounded and match the fast verdict line
body: Evidence and root cause: .krn/runs/audit/system-audit.md, row D1.

Outcome: a PreToolUse Bash rule refuses an until/while poll loop with sleep and no timeout bound; lanes.md and CLAUDE.md name the exact fast verdict line (fast PASS|FAIL) and tell agents to wait on the background exit, not grep.
Proof: a hook test refuses `until grep -q verdict f; do sleep 5; done` and accepts the same loop under `timeout 900`.
